title: Biblical Blessing for the Pope
text:
Let us pray for Francis, our Pope.
May the Lord preserve him, give him life,
make him blessed upon the earth,
and not hand him over to the will of his enemies.

May the Lord bless him and keep him.
May the Lord make his face shine upon him
and be gracious to him.
May the Lord turn his face toward him
and give him peace.
Amen.

translation.latin:
Oremus pro Francisco Papa nostro.
Dominus conservet eum, et vivificet eum,
et beatum faciat eum in terra,
et non tradat eum in animam inimicorum eius.

Benedicat illum Dominus, et custodiat eum.
Ostendat Dominus faciem suam illi,
et misereatur eius.
Convertat Dominus vultum suum ad illum,
et det ei pacem.
Amen.

attribution: Traditional Catholic Prayer (based on Psalm 41:2 and Numbers 6:24-26)
notes: This prayer combines biblical blessings for the Pope. The first part is based on Psalm 41:2, and the second part is the ancient Aaronic blessing from Numbers 6:24-26. It asks for God's protection, blessing, and peace upon the Holy Father in his ministry.
description: Prayer combining biblical blessings for the Pope's protection and peace
